description: This file defines classes and methods related to safe Firebase initialization, including runtime checks for Firebase configuration availability, and communicates initialization state without hard dependencies on firebase_core or firebase_options.dart.

classes.name: FirebaseOptionsProvider
classes.description: An abstract interface providing access to the current platform's Firebase options, allowing conditional imports or configurations.

classes.name: FirebaseInitState
classes.description: Represents the state of Firebase initialization, indicating whether Firebase is configured and initialized, along with an optional message.

classes.name: FirebaseSafeInit
classes.description: A class providing static methods for probing Firebase options availability and checking Firebase initialization state in a safe manner without hard dependencies.

methods.name: probeHasOptions
methods.description: Asynchronously determines whether Firebase options are available (e.g., checks for existence of specific configuration files) using heuristics based on platform and environment without importing firebase-specific files.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Returns an FirebaseInitState indicating whether Firebase is configured and ready for initialization, based on the probeHasOptions result.
